scope: Theorem 1.2 (Uniform effective log Iitaka fibrations) of the manuscript “Uniform effective log Iitaka fibrations for fourfolds” (preprints/Uniform-effective-log-Iitaka-fibrations-for-fourfolds-September-26-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 034 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8036215575dbf619), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 2. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Let Φ ⊂ [0, 1] ∩ Q be finite. There is a positive integer m = m(Φ) such that the following holds. Suppose X is a normal integral projective complex fourfold, ∆ ≥ 0 is a rational Weil divisor whose nonzero coefficients lie in Φ, (X, ∆) is lc, and D = KX + ∆ is rational Cartier and pseudo-effective. Then the complete system |⌊mD⌋| is nonempty and its section ratios generate K(D) inside C(X). The same integer works for every choice of canonical divisor on X.
